description: Miniature pose library (genericized). Includes bipedal_humanoid, quadrupedal, and facultatively_bipedal poses. Poses describe stance + hand actions + compatible prop geometry classes.

miniature_safe: At least one limb (foot/knee/hand) has clear contact with the base/terrain.
Arms and props should not merge into the torso silhouette; preserve negative space.
Avoid thin unsupported spans; prefer braced or close-to-body geometry for long props.
Base elements are low-profile unless explicitly needed for stability/readability.

schema.name: string
schema.pose_style: static | ready | dynamic | victory | crouch | kneel

poses.name: Guarded Low Ready
poses.pose_prompt: Feet shoulder-width, knees slightly bent; torso angled 10â€“20 degrees; MAIN_HAND_PROP visible low to the outside of the body with clear negative space (not crossing torso), not held in hands; off hand open or lightly clenched for balance; elbows away from ribs; head turned toward threat; keep chest/face unobstructed. No hands on MAIN_HAND_PROP; not gripped; not supported by hands.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; subtle ground texture only.

poses.name: Over-Shoulder Carry (Relaxed Threat)
poses.pose_prompt: Weight mostly on back leg; MAIN_HAND_PROP resting across the back shoulder line, kept outside head/neck silhouette; off hand relaxed at side; chest open; strong vertical silhouette.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; optional small low rock near rear foot.

poses.name: Forward Lunge Action
poses.pose_prompt: Front foot planted firmly, back foot planted with heel lifted; hips drive forward; MAIN_HAND_PROP visible forward and offset from torso for display only (symbolic silhouette), not actively wielded; off hand pulled back for counterbalance; maintain strong negative space under arms and between prop and body; face/chest unobstructed. No hands on MAIN_HAND_PROP; not gripped; not supported by hands.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with a shallow broken-stone slab or rubble ridge under the lead foot.

poses.name: Unarmed Fighter Ready
poses.pose_prompt: Unarmed fighting stance: feet wide and planted; knees bent; fists up at chest/face level; elbows away from torso; torso slightly forward; shoulders squared; head turned toward opponent; preserve negative space between forearms and body.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; minimal texture.

poses.name: Triumph / Rally
poses.pose_prompt: Feet planted wide; chest lifted; MAIN_HAND_PROP visible overhead as a symbolic silhouette element (no hand contact), not held in hands; off hand clenched or open near waist; elbows away from body; strong upward gesture without crossing head silhouette. No hands on MAIN_HAND_PROP; not gripped; not supported by hands.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with a low rock under one foot for a heroic height boost.

poses.name: Two-Hand Aim (Wide Stance)
poses.pose_prompt: Feet planted shoulder-width; torso rotated toward target; both hands engaged on a two-hand object: main hand at control point, off hand supporting/bracing; elbows lifted slightly away from torso; keep the full object silhouette readable and offset from the chest.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; minimal texture.

poses.name: Two-Hand Kneel Aim
poses.pose_prompt: One knee down firmly, forward foot planted; hips low; both hands engaged on a two-hand object; keep forearms separated from torso; maintain clear negative space around the object; head aligned with aim line.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with a low rubble mound supporting the kneeling contact.

poses.name: Two-Hand Dynamic Step Aim
poses.pose_prompt: Lead foot planted on raised terrain, trailing foot planted behind; torso twisted mid-aim; both hands engaged on a two-hand object; keep the object offset from the torso for a clean silhouette; cloth/gear may flow but must not cover hands or the object.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with a medium-low rock ledge under the lead foot.

poses.name: Dual Spread Aim
poses.pose_prompt: Supported dynamic advance: lead foot planted on raised terrain, trail foot planted behind; torso twisted; main-hand prop oriented outward for visual display, off-hand prop oriented opposite, both not held in hands; arms wide with elbows away from ribs; props not crossing the torso; head aligned toward main-hand orientation. No hand contact with MAIN_HAND_PROP or OFF_HAND_PROP; not gripped; not supported by hands.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with a low rock shelf under the lead foot; low rubble only.

poses.name: Long + Short Charge
poses.pose_prompt: Forward charge with both feet grounded: lead foot planted, rear foot planted with heel raised; main-hand long prop pulled back in a striking arc; off-hand compact/guard prop held forward-low and out to the side; keep both props outside the torso silhouette; strong negative space under elbows.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with a shallow ridge under the lead foot to emphasize momentum.

poses.name: Aim + Cover
poses.pose_prompt: Dynamic advance with asymmetric dual-wield: lead foot planted on raised terrain, rear foot grounded behind; torso rotated slightly toward main-hand aim; MAIN_HAND_PROP (compact weapon/tool) aimed forward with arm extended but offset from torso centerline, not crossing chest silhouette; OFF_HAND_PROP (shield or defensive plane) held down and angled away from body, slightly to the sideâ€”NOT vertical in front of chest, NOT used as firing platform; clear negative space between weapon arm, shield, and torso; arms must not collapse into flat frontal plane; chest and face fully readable; head turned toward aim line; shield and weapon must not overlap torso.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with a low rock shelf under the lead foot; minimal debris only.

poses.name: CQB Forward
poses.pose_prompt: Close-quarters stance: feet planted wide; torso angled; main-hand compact prop visible forward and slightly offset as a symbolic element (not held in hands); off-hand compact prop visible low and out to the side (no hand contact); elbows away from ribs; strong negative space between forearms and body; forward lean; keep face/chest readable. No hand contact with MAIN_HAND_PROP or OFF_HAND_PROP; not gripped; not supported by hands.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; optional low curb/step near front toe for contact emphasis.

poses.name: Guardian Vigil
poses.pose_prompt: Protective vigil stance: feet planted wide and stable; weight centered; torso upright with calm presence; MAIN_HAND_PROP visible low and angled outward from body (barrel/tip upward if long) as a symbolic element, not held in hands; OFF_HAND_PROP replaced by an empty-hand warding/blessing gesture at chest/shoulder level; elbows away from ribs; strong vertical silhouette with clear negative space between arms and torso; head level with resolute gaze; avoid crossing items over the chest. No hands on MAIN_HAND_PROP; not gripped; not supported by hands.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; subtle ground texture only.

poses.name: Defensive Crouch
poses.pose_prompt: Low defensive crouch: feet wide with knees deeply bent, hips low; torso leaning forward; MAIN_HAND_PROP held diagonally across body at mid-height, angled outward for clear negative space; off hand extended low for balance or defensive gesture; weight on balls of feet; head forward with alert posture; prop kept away from torso silhouette.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; minimal texture.

poses.name: Sprint Carry
poses.pose_prompt: Dynamic sprint: lead foot planted on raised terrain, rear foot pushing off; torso leaning forward with running momentum; MAIN_HAND_PROP carried horizontally at side or angled back, kept clear of torso; off hand pumping back for balance; head forward; strong diagonal silhouette suggesting forward motion.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with low rock under lead foot.

poses.name: Overhead Strike
poses.pose_prompt: Overhead strike: feet planted in forward stance; MAIN_HAND_PROP raised high overhead in striking arc, kept outside head silhouette; off hand extended low for balance; torso rotated toward strike; weight shifting forward; strong vertical reach with clear negative space.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface.

poses.name: Side Guard Low
poses.pose_prompt: Side guard stance: feet shoulder-width; torso turned 45 degrees; MAIN_HAND_PROP held low at side with grip/stock at hip level, barrels angled sharply upward (approximately 35â€“45 degrees), with the muzzle clearly higher than the stock in screen space; strong upward foreshortening visible; entire prop from grip to tip clearly visible and separated from thigh and body; off hand raised in defensive position near chest; strong negative space between prop and torso; ready but patient posture.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; minimal texture.

poses.name: Two-Hand Low Sweep
poses.pose_prompt: Low sweeping strike: wide stance with knees bent; torso rotated; both hands engaged on two-hand object in horizontal sweeping arc at waist/hip level; prop kept clear of torso with strong negative space; head turned toward sweep direction; dynamic rotation.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface.

poses.name: Two-Hand Overhead Chop
poses.pose_prompt: Overhead chop: lead foot forward on raised terrain; both hands gripping two-hand object raised high overhead in chopping arc; kept outside head silhouette; torso leaning forward; weight shifting onto lead foot; powerful downward strike posture.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with low rock under lead foot.

poses.name: Two-Hand March Carry
poses.pose_prompt: Marching carry: feet planted in walking stance; both hands holding two-hand object resting on shoulder or carried diagonally across back; casual march posture; object kept outside head/neck silhouette; calm confident stride.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface.

poses.name: Two-Hand Defensive Brace
poses.pose_prompt: Defensive brace: wide stable stance; both hands gripping two-hand object held diagonally across body at chest/shoulder height; angled to deflect rather than block straight-on; torso turned slightly; defensive ready posture with clear negative space.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; minimal texture.

poses.name: Unarmed Aggressive Charge
poses.pose_prompt: Aggressive charge: lead foot planted on raised terrain, rear foot pushing; one fist/claw extended forward in striking position; other hand pulled back for power; torso leaning forward; head forward with aggressive expression; dynamic forward momentum.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with low rock under lead foot.

poses.name: Unarmed Defensive Crouch
poses.pose_prompt: Defensive crouch: feet wide with knees deeply bent, hips low; hands up in guarding positionsâ€”one forward, one to side; torso forward; weight on balls of feet; alert ready posture; strong negative space between arms and body.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface.

poses.name: Unarmed Victory Roar
poses.pose_prompt: Victory roar: wide powerful stance with one foot on raised terrain; both arms raised high in triumphant gestureâ€”fists clenched or claws spread; head thrown back in roaring expression; chest open; dominant victory posture.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with low rock under one foot.

poses.name: Dual Spinning Strike
poses.pose_prompt: Spinning strike: feet planted with torso rotated 90+ degrees suggesting spin motion; both compact props extended outward in opposite directions at torso height; arms wide with elbows away from body; strong horizontal silhouette; clear negative space between props, arms, and torso; dynamic rotation implied.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface.

poses.name: Dual Crossed Defense
poses.pose_prompt: Crossed defensive stance: feet wide and stable; MAIN_HAND_PROP and OFF_HAND_PROP both raised and angled inward to create an X or crossed formation in front of body; held away from torso at mid-chest height with clear negative space; defensive posture; props must not merge into torso silhouette.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; minimal texture.

poses.name: Dual Asymmetric Ready
poses.pose_prompt: Asymmetric ready: feet shoulder-width; MAIN_HAND_PROP (compact) held forward in ready/aim position at shoulder height; OFF_HAND_PROP (long or compact) held low at side in relaxed carry; torso slightly turned; calm alert posture; both props kept clear of torso with negative space.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface.

poses.name: Shield Bash Charge
poses.pose_prompt: Shield bash charge: lead foot planted on raised terrain; MAIN_HAND_PROP (shield) held forward in ramming position, angled slightly downward; off hand pulled back for momentum; torso leaning forward with charging posture; shield kept clear of face/head; aggressive forward drive.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with low rock under lead foot.

poses.name: Weapon Transition
poses.pose_prompt: Weapon transition: feet in ready stance; MAIN_HAND_PROP (long/compact) held low and angled away as if lowering or holstering; OFF_HAND_PROP (compact/small) raised forward in ready position; mid-transition posture between stances; both props visible with clear separation from torso.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface.

poses.name: Low Stalking
poses.pose_prompt: Low stalking quadruped pose: body low to ground, all four legs visible and separated, spine arched slightly, head forward, predatory focus; clear definition between legs and torso; weight distributed evenly.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface with subtle ground texture.

poses.name: Charging Run
poses.pose_prompt: Charging quadruped: powerful forward momentum, extended front leg reaching, rear legs driving, spine stretched in running gait; all legs clearly visible and separated; dynamic forward lean.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface with motion implied.

poses.name: Howling
poses.pose_prompt: Howling quadruped: head thrown back, muzzle pointed upward, chest expanded, all four legs planted firmly; body stable and grounded; clear separation between legs.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface, slight elevation implied by posture only.

poses.name: Seated Watch
poses.pose_prompt: Seated watch quadruped: rear haunches seated, front legs straight and upright, head alert and forward-facing; dignified sentinel posture; all legs clearly visible.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface.

poses.name: Circling
poses.pose_prompt: Circling quadruped: body angled in circular motion, legs positioned for turning gait, head turned to track prey; all four legs visible; weight shifting into turn.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface with implied circular motion.

poses.name: Long Distance Lope
poses.pose_prompt: Endurance lope quadruped: efficient running gait, elongated stride, legs extended in loping rhythm; relaxed but relentless posture; all legs clearly defined.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface.

poses.name: Overhead Display
poses.pose_prompt: Bipedal overhead display: standing upright on digitigrade legs, MAIN_HAND_PROP raised overhead as dramatic element, angled away from body for clear negative space; chest and torso fully exposed; arms raised for dramatic composition; both shoulders/arms/chest/face visible.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface.

poses.name: Full Howl
poses.pose_prompt: Bipedal howling: head thrown back in supernatural howl, MAIN_HAND_PROP extended outward showing full torso, off-hand visible; ecstatic commanding howl pose with both arms clearly visible and separated from body.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface.

poses.name: Low Sweeping Pose
poses.pose_prompt: Bipedal low sweep: low stance on digitigrade legs, MAIN_HAND_PROP extended away from torso in sweeping arc at low height; strong silhouette with weapon distinct from body.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface.

poses.name: Menacing Advance
poses.pose_prompt: Bipedal menacing advance: forward stepping stance on digitigrade legs, MAIN_HAND_PROP positioned forward and away from body; threatening forward lean; upright stance with full torso visible.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; rock step with forward momentum.
